cues: Simplex goes one way only, like television.
Half duplex goes both ways, but one at a time, like a walkie talkie: say over.
Full duplex goes both ways at once, like a phone call.
text: Transmission modes. Simplex goes one way only, like television. Half duplex goes both ways, but one at a time, like a walkie talkie: say over. Full duplex goes both ways at once, like a phone call.
